primary.title: Bengal weighs pooling closed PSUs
primary.description: Kolkata: West Bengal government is looking at a large pool of available land of closed Central PSUs, State PSUs and sick industries, some close private companies, central government owned and private jute mills and cotton mills for preparing land bank, making it available for the industry. Meanwhile, on Thursday, the industrial policy related meeting was held by the Group of Ministers led by the industry department.According to Project BhoomiShakti, the strategic blueprint for recovery, monetization, redevelopment of investment-ready industrial land in West Bengal, has been prepared by a chamber of commerce, several land parcels have been identified. However, there are legal predicaments, encroachments of the idle lands of the close CPSUs and jute mills and many other issues which have come up in the process, industry department sources said."Land Bank are being put together, to make it easier for the industry," said Vandana Yadava, Principal Secretary, Department of Industry & Commerce.Also read: Foreign nationals don't have inherent right to seek entry into India: Delhi HC
